We understand choosing the right suitcase can be confusing, and we’re glad you asked.

Here’s a comparison of our two key, feature-rich options:

Pro Series

Aerospace‑grade polycarbonate shell
360° Japanese ball‑bearing spinner wheels with noise reduction (replaceable)
Aerospace‑grade aluminium telescopic handle with maximum load capacity
Latest 008 TSA lock
Compression pad and laundry bag included
Rated “Excellent” for durability using 100% German virgin polycarbonate at full shell thickness
Designed for frequent travellers who want maximum comfort, performance, and convenience

Essential Series

German premium polycarbonate hard shell (100% virgin polycarbonate at full shell thickness)
Telescopic handle with four adjustment settings
TSA‑approved combination lock
Four high‑end 360° spinner wheels from Japan
Mesh divider with two‑way zips
High‑quality, water‑resistant lining
Also rated “Excellent” for durability
Same core robustness as Pro, but with a leaner feature set

Across all our series (including Pro and Essential), you always get:

Robust premium polycarbonate shell
Quiet 360° spinner wheels
Multi‑stage telescopic handle

Which is better for you?

Choose Pro Series if:

You travel very frequently (e.g., weekly or monthly)
You value maximum comfort, ultra‑smooth wheels, and a sturdier aluminium handle
You want extra interior organisation (compression pad + laundry bag)
You’re happy to pay a bit more for top‑of‑the‑line features

Choose Essential Series if:

You want top quality and durability but don’t need every premium upgrade
You prefer a more straightforward interior (mesh divider instead of compression pad)
You want a robust, long‑lasting suitcase at a slightly more accessible price point

If you’re unsure, the Essential Series usually fits most travellers very well, while the Pro Series is ideal if you know you’ll use the added comfort and features on frequent trips.

You can explore and compare our ranges here:

👉 Compare all suitcases: https://horizn-studios.com/pages/compare/
👉 Pro Series: https://horizn-studios.com/collections/pro-series
👉 Essential Series: https://horizn-studios.com/collections/essential-series
